mapper.select: WITH funds AS () SELECT orders.order_count,orders.order_payable,confirmed.paid_order_count,confirmed.normal_receipt, confirmed.abnormal_receipt,confirmed.normal_refund,confirmed.abnormal_refund FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count,COALESCE(SUM(payable_amount),0) AS order_payable FROM tc_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND currency=#{currency} AND created_at >= #{q.createdFrom} AND created_at < #{q.createdTo} ) orders CROSS JOIN ( SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN kind='NORMAL_RECEIPT' THEN 1 END) AS paid_order_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind='NORMAL_RECEIPT' THEN amount END),0) AS normal_receipt, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind='ABNORMAL_RECEIPT' THEN amount END),0) AS abnormal_receipt, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind='NORMAL_REFUND' THEN amount END),0) AS normal_refund, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind='ABNORMAL_REFUND' THEN amount END),0) AS abnormal_refund FROM funds ) confirmed

WITH funds AS () SELECT business_date, SUM(order_count) AS order_count, SUM(paid_order_count) AS paid_order_count, SUM(normal_receipt) AS normal_receipt, SUM(normal_refund) AS normal_refund FROM ( SELECT DATE(TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR,8,created_at)) AS business_date, COUNT(*) AS order_count, 0 AS paid_order_count, 0 AS normal_receipt, 0 AS normal_refund FROM tc_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND currency=#{currency} AND created_at >= #{q.createdFrom} AND created_at < #{q.createdTo} GROUP BY DATE(TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR,8,created_at)) UNION ALL SELECT DATE(TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR,8,confirmed_at)), 0, COUNT(CASE WHEN kind='NORMAL_RECEIPT' THEN 1 END), COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind='NORMAL_RECEIPT' THEN amount END),0), COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN kind='NORMAL_REFUND' THEN amount END),0) FROM funds GROUP BY DATE(TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR,8,confirmed_at)) ) by_day GROUP BY business_date ORDER BY business_date

WITH funds AS () SELECT f.ledger_id,f.ledger_no,f.business_no,o.order_no,f.receipt_no,f.refund_no, o.business_no AS order_business_no,f.receipt_business_no,r.business_no AS refund_business_no, f.kind,f.amount,f.currency,f.confirmed_at
ORDER BY f.ledger_id LIMIT #{q.fetchLimit}

WITH funds AS () SELECT f.ledger_id,f.ledger_no,f.business_no,o.order_no,f.receipt_no,f.refund_no, o.business_no AS order_business_no,f.receipt_business_no,r.business_no AS refund_business_no, f.kind,f.amount,f.currency,f.confirmed_at
ORDER BY f.ledger_id LIMIT #{q.limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS linked_count, COUNT(b.funding_application_id) AS funding_count, COALESCE(SUM(b.discount_minor),0) AS discount

SELECT o.order_no,o.business_no, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(b.evidence_json,'$.commerceTenantId')) AS commerce_tenant, b.store_id,b.commerce_quote_id,b.funding_application_id,o.created_at
ORDER BY o.created_at DESC,o.id DESC LIMIT #{q.limit} OFFSET #{offset}
